mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 68 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Waning Gibbous moon, with an overnight low of 61 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department Records Section handles all public records requests. If you need a DT4000 crash report, those are generally available online 10 days after the event, while other supplemental reports can be requested directly from the department with potential redactions applied.

There is a lot happening in our community. Today, you can attend the Remote Area Medical Clinic at the high school or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is happening tomorrow, followed by trivia nights and the farmer's market starting on August 5th.

During the week of July 20th through the 27th, officers handled several calls, including an incident on July 26th where a driver was cited for a hit and run crash near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Cheesecake, though the store is currently closed. They will open tomorrow at 10 AM, when the flavor of the day will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
